# AI with Rakshith (aiwithrakshith.tech)

> Rakshith is an AI Generalist and the Founder & CEO of MyDesignNexus, an MSME-registered AI solutions company in Hassan & Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. He builds AI automation, AI calling agents, web and app products, custom software and AI-produced content for small and growing businesses across India, and teaches AI in Kannada.

## Who
- Name: Rakshith
- Role: AI Generalist; Founder & CEO, MyDesignNexus
- Location: Hassan & Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (IST, UTC+5:30)
- Background: Computer Science Engineering graduate (2025); learned AI through US-based communities, freelanced, then founded MyDesignNexus
- Languages: English, Kannada
- Hands-on with 300+ AI tools (91 premium); 20+ projects delivered; 3.2M+ Reel plays

## Services (MyDesignNexus)
1. AI Automation: workflow automation and business systems for SMEs
2. AI Calling Agents: voice agents for sales, support and lead handling
3. Web & App Development: websites, PWAs and mobile apps
4. Custom Software: tailored tools for real business problems
5. AI Content Production: AI video, UGC ads, AI avatar videos and visual content (MDN Creatives)
6. AI Education: Kannada-first AI learning content

## Products
- ContentBrisk: a content management system for creators and brands (launching soon)
- Adsynthra: an AI-powered ad platform (coming soon)
